title: agent-workflows run state (protocol 0.1)
description: Validates `{run}/workflow-state.yaml` — the runtime state with exactly one writer, the executor: run identity and risk, per-step status, the gate instrumentation record, optional enrichment, and the artifact manifest (spec section 10). The format is protocol-owned, so unknown keys are rejected.

run.description: Run identity: id, workflow, risk class with its mandatory rationale, and the protocol version the run executes under (spec sections 5 and 10).

id.description: Run identifier; also names the run directory {artifacts}/runs/<run-id>/ (spec section 8.1).

workflow.description: The workflow this run executes, e.g. feature, bugfix, plan (spec section 6.1).

risk.description: The risk class recorded at intake; mid-run reclassification is upward only (spec sections 5.1 and 5.3).

protocol.description: Protocol version the run executes under, `<major>.<minor>` (spec section 11).

steps.description: Per-step execution record; resume = first step whose status is not done or skipped (spec sections 8.5 and 10).

gates.description: The gate instrumentation record required by spec section 7: id, transport, outcome, timestamp for every gate decision.

instrumentation.description: Optional per-step enrichment such as token counts and durations (spec section 10).

artifacts.description: The run manifest: artifacts the run has produced, kept current by the executor (spec section 8.2).

iterations.description: Iterations consumed against the loop cap (spec sections 9.2 and 10).

stall_flags.description: Accumulated stall or drift signals (spec sections 9.2 and 10).

transport.description: How the decision was collected (spec section 7).

at.description: When the decision was recorded (spec section 7).
